GlobalAppState.title: GlobalAppState
GlobalAppState.description: Single consolidated document storing site lock state, security hashes, announcements, lesson materials metadata, and custom student records to minimize Firestore read quota consumption.

requireStudentLogin.description: Whether the site is locked to registered student IDs only.

accessUpdatedAtMs.description: Timestamp in ms when site access lock was last updated.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the admin password.

proofDigestB64.description: Base64 SHA-256 digest of the admin write secret.

wrappedRosterKey.description: Wrapped AES-GCM master key for the student roster.

announcements.description: Bounded map of announcements keyed by announcement ID.

materials.description: Bounded map of lesson materials metadata keyed by material ID.

customStudents.description: Bounded map of custom or modified student status records keyed by authHash.

directory.description: Bounded map of encrypted admin student directory entries keyed by authHash.

updatedAtMs.description: Last modification epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

adminProof.description: Cryptographic admin write secret verified by Firestore rules.

StudentPreference.title: StudentPreference
StudentPreference.description: Per-student schedule filter preferences keyed by derived cloudDocId.

PdfChunk.title: PdfChunk
PdfChunk.description: Chunked binary base64 storage for uploaded PDF files when running without a local file server.

/appState/{stateId}.description: Quota-friendly single document (stateId == 'global') containing consolidated site lock, announcements, materials metadata, and custom student overrides.

/studentPrefs/{cloudKey}.description: Individual student preferences accessed by 64-char hex cloudKey without list queries.

/pdfChunks/{chunkDocId}.description: Individual PDF base64 chunks accessed by deterministic chunkDocId without list queries.
